tasks.label: Start Home Assistant
tasks.command: if docker ps > /dev/null 2>&1 && docker ps | grep -q hassio_supervisor; then echo 'Home Assistant supervisor is already running'; docker ps | grep hassio_supervisor; elif docker ps > /dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'Docker is running but supervisor container not found. Starting...'; nohup supervisor_run > /tmp/supervisor.log 2>&1 & sleep 5; echo 'Supervisor starting. Check /tmp/supervisor.log for details.'; else echo 'Starting Home Assistant (Docker may take up to 30 seconds to start)...'; nohup supervisor_run > /tmp/supervisor.log 2>&1 & sleep 10; for i in {1..6}; do if docker ps > /dev/null 2>&1; then echo "Docker started successfully"; break; else echo "Waiting for Docker... ($i/6)"; sleep 5; fi; done; if docker ps > /dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'Home Assistant supervisor is starting. Check /tmp/supervisor.log for details.'; else echo 'Error: Docker failed to start. Check /tmp/supervisor.log'; fi; fi

tasks.label: Restart Home Assistant
tasks.command: echo 'Stopping Home Assistant...'; pkill -f 'supervisor_run|supervisor' || true; sleep 2; echo 'Starting Home Assistant...'; nohup supervisor_run > /tmp/supervisor.log 2>&1 & sleep 3; if pgrep -f 'supervisor_run|supervisor' > /dev/null; then echo 'Home Assistant restarted successfully'; else echo 'Failed to restart. Check /tmp/supervisor.log'; fi

tasks.label: Start Addon
tasks.command: ha apps stop "local_${input:addonName}"; ha apps start "local_${input:addonName}"; docker logs --follow "addon_local_${input:addonName}"

tasks.label: Update and Start Addon
tasks.command: ha apps stop "local_${input:addonName}" 2>&1 || true; ha apps update "local_${input:addonName}"; docker exec hassio_supervisor python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('/data/addons.json')); s=d['system']['local_${input:addonName}']; s['schema']['long_lived_token']='str?'; s['options']['long_lived_token']=''; s['homeassistant_api']=True; svcs=s.setdefault('services',[]); svcs_names=[x.get('name','') if isinstance(x,dict) else x for x in svcs]; svcs.append({'name':'mqtt','protocol':'tcp'}) if 'mqtt' not in svcs_names else None; json.dump(d,open('/data/addons.json','w')); print('Supervisor cache patched')" 2>&1 || true; ha apps start "local_${input:addonName}"; docker logs --follow "addon_local_${input:addonName}"

tasks.label: Rebuild and Start Addon
tasks.command: ha apps stop "local_${input:addonName}" 2>&1 || true; IMGID=$(docker inspect "addon_local_${input:addonName}" --format='{{.Image}}' 2>/dev/null); docker rm -f "addon_local_${input:addonName}" 2>/dev/null || true; [ -n "$IMGID" ] && docker rmi -f "$IMGID" 2>/dev/null || true; ha apps rebuild --force "local_${input:addonName}"; docker exec hassio_supervisor python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('/data/addons.json')); s=d['system']['local_${input:addonName}']; s['schema']['long_lived_token']='str?'; s['options']['long_lived_token']=''; s['homeassistant_api']=True; svcs=s.setdefault('services',[]); svcs_names=[x.get('name','') if isinstance(x,dict) else x for x in svcs]; svcs.append({'name':'mqtt','protocol':'tcp'}) if 'mqtt' not in svcs_names else None; json.dump(d,open('/data/addons.json','w')); print('Supervisor cache patched')" 2>&1 || true; ha apps start "local_${input:addonName}"; docker logs --follow "addon_local_${input:addonName}"

inputs.description: Name of addon (to add your addon to this list, please edit .vscode/tasks.json)
